title: Build an API Response Inspector
summary: Combine request/response vocabulary, statuses, headers, and JSON-body reasoning in a cumulative Node.js inspection utility.

sketchBlocks.title: Inspect one API response as a complete contract
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
Build a small **API Response Inspector**. You are not creating an Express server yet. Instead, you will receive one JavaScript object that represents an HTTP exchange and build utilities that explain it.

The finished program will report:

- method and endpoint
- numeric status and status family
- content type
- a useful body summary

This project keeps Module 1 focused on HTTP reasoning. In Module 2, these same ideas move into real Express route handlers.

sketchBlocks.title: Each milestone keeps the previous solution
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
The five milestones are cumulative. Every starter contains the complete solution from the previous milestone.

Do not replace the response object with hardcoded report text. The inspector should derive its report from the response data so the same functions can inspect different responses later.

quizDraft.title: Milestone 1: Store the response record
quizDraft.prompt: Create the complete `response` object with method, endpoint, status, headers, and body, then log it.
quizDraft.hint: Preserve the complete working solution from the previous milestone and add only the new responsibility.
